name: Daughter Maker 2
source:
Ayamori Mikihiko, 35 years of a somewhat noble birth, lives in a mansion of western suburb. Without any job, he relies on the money of his family, and the only person beside him is his old butler. From certain events of the past, he was not able to love any women but little girls. One day, fraternal (non-identical) twins of a distant family are adopted and moved into his mansion. Days to spend with these girls, and the girl from his memory – what was their pasts, and what lies ahead of their lives?

[Edited DMM product summary]
translation:
绫森干彦，35岁，出身贵族，住在西郊的一座豪宅里。他没有任何工作，全靠家里的钱，身边唯一的人就是他的老管家。从过去的某些事情来看，他除了小女孩之外，不能爱任何女人。有一天，一个远方家庭的异卵双胞胎被收养并搬进了他的豪宅。和这些女孩一起度过的日子，以及他记忆中的女孩——他们的过去是什么，他们的未来又是什么？

[编辑DMM产品摘要]
